newsitem.title: USA: White Rose Foods and unit commence tender offers.
newsitem.headline: White Rose Foods and unit commence tender offers.

text.p: White Rose Foods Inc and its Di Giorgio Corp subsidiary said on Friday that they had begun tender offers and consent solicitations for senior notes of both companies in an operation that expires June 16.

The offer includes all outstanding White Rose senior discount notes due 1998, and all Di Giorgio 12 percent senior notes due 2003. The total offering price for the White Rose notes is $900.35 per $1,000 face principal amount, the companies said.
The total offering price for the Di Giorgio notes is $1,072.04 per share per $1,000 principal amount, they added.
Merrill Lynch and Co and GT Securities Corp are acting as dealer managers for the tender offers and consent solicitations, the companies said.
White Rose Foods Inc is a privately-held company.
